faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIFTEM JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIFTEM is 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 60% marks in Food Science and Technology, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or closely allied fields.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for women, SC, ST, OBC, and differently-abled candidates as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the JRF post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 37,000/- plus 10% HRA per month for the initial six months, which is extendable.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the JRF post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position at NIFTEM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to fill out the application form through the provided link.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the NIFTEM JRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview, which can be conducted in-person or online.

faq.question: Q9. Are candidates with prior experience preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with relevant work experience in New Product Development or plant proteins will be given preference.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the contract for the JRF position?
faq.answer: The position is purely contractual for six months, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements and candidate performance.
